meta.source: Ahmedabad + Gandhinagar municipal ward maps (digitised) + OSM-measured road network
meta.population_basis: AMC Census 2011 (5,570,585) projected to 2026 at ~2.3%/yr ; GMC Census 2011 (208,299) projected to 2026
meta.population_method: each municipality's own census total distributed within its own wards by area_km2 x road_density^1.35, then the two ward sets combined
